title: 第14章 传话
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
残阳如血，晚霞将天边烧成一片暗沉的橘红。

    淡金色的余晖从敞开的门扉照进客厅，在地板上拖出一道惨白的光带，一直延伸至苏牧脚下，将他的影子拉得又细又长，像一道被钉在地上的灰色裂痕。

    苏牧呆坐在桌前，手里捏着酒杯，看着光束里翩翩起舞的细小尘埃，不知哪一粒是自己。

    脑海里画面一帧一帧铺展开来，是他和沈南初一路走来的点点滴滴。

    他记得第一次见面，当时比自己还高半个头的沈南初拿鼻孔瞧人，斜着眼恶狠狠地说“看什么看，再看把你眼珠子挖出来”，第一感觉是，穿着像个小乞丐的丫头片子匪气十足。

    他记得十七岁的那个雨夜，彼此熟络已经成了朋友，沈南初第一次交心，道出了自己的身世，还真是土匪出身，父母都是炼气圆满的匪修，领着十几个修士和一群武者占山为王，后来山寨被朝廷围剿覆灭，侥幸逃出生天的沈南初当时只有十二岁，只身辗转三年来到青云宗。

    他记得那次黄蜂谷历练之行，两人历经一番厮杀，躲在一处山洞修养疗伤，篝火旁，沈南初趁自己不备，蜻蜓点水般在自己唇上亲了一下，那苍白的俏脸染上红霞，在火光映照下娇媚动人，沈南初一如既往的直接，说“我喜欢你，咱们结为道侣吧”。

    想到此处，苏牧嘴角不自觉勾起一丝笑意，心中嘀咕：这算哪门子初吻。

    他将杯中残酒喝下，不禁幽幽轻叹，二十五年的记忆，恍如昨日。

    突然，门口响起一声叫喊：“苏牧！”

    苏牧抬头瞧去，心头顿时一个激灵，脑子嗡嗡作响，诸多飘飞的思绪瞬间烟消云散，被危机和警兆取代。

    一时间，他大脑宕机失去了思考，却本能地连忙站起，快步迎上前，面带一丝疑惑拱手：“陈师兄！方师兄！”

    陈决面无表情道：“苏牧，有桩案子需要你协助调查，跟我们走一趟。”

    “案子？”苏牧眨眼问了句，在三人脸上依次扫过，这才恢复思考能力。

    智者千虑，必有一失，眼前的一幕完全在他预料之外，为了确保不会出现变数，他特意让楚阳反复确认过，执法殿确实判定鸢斯为真凶，还张贴了告示，封存档案了，所以李构之死，在他心里已经尘埃落定，只剩林语山一个隐患。

    【莫非是林语山那边出了问题，告发了我？应该不是……难道是执法殿迷惑凶手，故意结案让凶手放松警惕，好暗中调查？】

    念头一闪而过，苏牧脸上疑惑更甚，问道：“李构师兄的案子？不是结了吗？”

    方一隆似笑非笑道：“看来你对李构案子很关心呐！”
content_en:
The setting sun is like blood, and the sunset burns the sky into a dark orange.

    The pale golden afterglow shone into the living room from the open door, dragging a pale strip of light on the floor, extending all the way to Su Mu's feet, making his shadow thin and long, like a gray crack nailed to the ground.

    Su Mu sat blankly at the table, holding the wine glass in his hand, looking at the tiny dust particles dancing in the light beam, not knowing which one was him.

    The pictures in his mind unfolded frame by frame, showing every detail of his journey with Shen Nanchu.

    He remembered the first time they met. At that time, Shen Nanchu, who was half a head taller than him, looked at the person with his nostrils, squinted and said viciously, "Look at what you are looking at, and I will dig out your eyeballs if I look at it." His first impression was that the girl dressed like a little beggar was very treacherous.

    He remembered the rainy night when he was seventeen years old. They got to know each other and became friends. Shen Nanchu had a heart-to-heart relationship for the first time and revealed his life experience. He was really a bandit. His parents were bandit cultivators who had perfected their qi. He led a dozen monks and a group of warriors to occupy the mountain and became the king. Later, the village was surrounded and destroyed by the imperial court. Shen Nanchu, who had a chance to escape, was only twelve years old at the time. He spent three years alone to come to Qingyun Sect.

    He remembered that trip to the Hornet Valley for training. The two of them fought a lot and hid in a cave to recuperate. Beside the campfire, Shen Nanchu took advantage of him and kissed him on the lips like a dragonfly. Her pale and pretty face was stained with red clouds, charming and charming under the firelight. Shen Nanchu was as direct as ever and said, "I like you, let's become a Taoist couple."

    Thinking of this, Su Mu unconsciously smiled, and murmured in his heart: What kind of first kiss is this?

    He drank the remaining wine in the cup and couldn't help but sigh. The memory of twenty-five years seemed like yesterday.

    Suddenly, a cry came from the door: "Su Mu!"

    Su Mu raised his head and looked up, his heart suddenly stirred, his mind was buzzing, and all the wandering thoughts disappeared in an instant, replaced by crises and warning signs.

    For a moment, his brain shut down and he lost his thoughts, but he stood up instinctively, walked forward quickly, and handed over his hands with a trace of confusion on his face: "Senior Brother Chen! Senior Brother Fang!"

    Chen Jue said expressionlessly: "Su Mu, there is a case that we need your assistance in investigating. Please come with us."

    "Case?" Su Mu blinked and asked, scanning the faces of the three people one by one, and then regained his ability to think.

    A wise man is bound to make mistakes. The scene in front of him was completely unexpected. In order to ensure that there would be no changes, he specifically asked Chu Yang to confirm repeatedly that the Law Enforcement Hall had indeed determined that Yuan Si was the real murderer. It also posted a notice and sealed the file. Therefore, Li Gou's death had been settled in his heart, and only Lin Yushan was left as a hidden danger.

    [Could it be that there was something wrong with Lin Yushan and he reported me? Probably not... Could it be that the Law Enforcement Hall confuses the murderer and deliberately closes the case to make the murderer relax his vigilance so that he can investigate secretly? 】

    The thought flashed across his face, and Su Mu's face became even more confused, and he asked: "Senior Brother Li Gou's case? Isn't it closed?"

    Fang Yilong said with a faint smile: "It seems that you are very concerned about Li Gou's case!"
